comment: The workspace's pages, shared by the frontend router and the lead agent's page links (optimization_framework/agents/pages.py). Addresses are #<page>[/<sub>][/<record_id>]; the router puts the current thread in front (#t/<thread>/...).

note.title: Problem note
note.description: the problem note the lead drafts with you: objective, knobs, observables, noise, constraints, confounders, open questions; its revisions, and the charter it is adopted into

hypotheses.title: Hypotheses
hypotheses.description: every proposal with its mechanism, reviews and status; the discussion moderator takes requests here; one proposal: #hypotheses/<hypothesis_id>

experiments.title: Experiments
experiments.description: every run with its progress, score curve and best design, and drafts not yet started; one run: #experiments/<trial_id>; the experiment operator takes requests here

evolution.title: Evolution
evolution.description: how the strategies evolved: the frontier table, the lineage of every candidate, score curves at matched cost, and the races

files.title: Files
files.description: recorded findings and assets, report drafts (one draft: /reports/<report_id>), the notebook and the sources read

inbox.title: Inbox
inbox.description: what waits for your approval, choice or answer

monitor.title: Monitor
monitor.description: machine load, measured evaluation speed, budgets and forecasts, model usage, race progress, the agent team and its log; the resource planner takes requests here

library.title: Library
library.description: strategies that won earlier campaigns of the same problem, ready to apply

branches.title: Branches
branches.description: the map of this campaign's conversation branches with their summaries
